title: A narrow credential an agent asks its organization for, credential-request/1 (DEC-0111)
description: Sent in a check-in's records.credentialRequests inside the signed device request; the device and its organization come from the transport. It names an agent and a context, never a person, and carries no value. FAC-SEM-138: the context is the enrollment's own organization; the credential is asked for after the request and for at most 30 days; the reason and the scope carry no path and no credential. docs/specification/credentials.md#the-request.

requestId.description: the request's id, chosen by the node; the decision and the envelope name it

agentRef.description: the agent instance asking, in the context below

provider.description: the provider the credential is for, e.g. cloudflare or openrouter

preset.description: a preset the organization's issuer lists (a scope, a spend limit and its reset), by name

scope.description: what the credential reaches, by name (a zone, an account, a model list); the preset bounds it

expiresAt.description: when the credential should end: after requestedAt, at most 30 days after it (FAC-SEM-138)

reason.description: one line the administrator reads: why the agent needs it. Never a path, a command or a secret.
